from decimal import Decimal, getcontext
from pathlib import Path
getcontext().prec = 50
rows=[]
with Path('/workspace/tmp/phykit_metrics.tabular').open() as fh:
    header=fh.readline().rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    for line in fh:
        if not line.strip(): continue
        rec=dict(zip(header,line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')))
        if rec['status']=='ok':
            rows.append((rec['group'],Decimal(rec['value'])))
groups={g:sorted(v for gg,v in rows if gg==g) for g in ('animals','fungi')}
def median(vals):
    n=len(vals)
    if n%2: return vals[n//2]
    return (vals[n//2-1]+vals[n//2])/Decimal(2)
med={g:median(v) for g,v in groups.items()}
print('counts', {g:len(v) for g,v in groups.items()})
print('medians', {g:str(x) for g,x in med.items()})
print('fungi/animals', med['fungi']/med['animals'])
print('animals/fungi', med['animals']/med['fungi'])
PY"
